items.name: FNCS Solos Reload Qualifier
items.notes: Dates match Epic’s published schedule (Round 1 on 3–4 Nov, Round 2 on 7 Nov, Round 3 on 8 Nov). Time from Fortnite Tracker’s EU listing (18:00–20:30), read as UTC. Fortnite.GG lists a 07:00 UTC slot instead, so check the Compete tab in-game. Round 1 is open to the top 200,000 in global Power Rankings; the top 1,000 skip to Round 2.

items.name: Trios Cash Cup
items.notes: Fortnite Tracker lists the EU event at 14:00–17:00 without a timezone; read as UTC because Fortnite.GG lists a 14:00 UTC Trios Cash Cup session the same day. Rank requirement as quoted from Fortnite Tracker (Diamond in Combined Ranked for Event 1, Champion for Events 2 and 3). Prizes are paid per player.
